title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: SHNs were decoded to wave and Audition 3.0 was used to reassemble the tracks back to 1 long wave.  Audition 3.0 was used to align & synch the SBD & AUD sources.  Audition 3.0 used to adjust the volume for AUDs, matrix/CTR and LFE channels.
source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shn id 89313) MAC > R1 7.5ips 1/4 track > Technics RS-1506 > Grace designs Lunatec V3 (pre only) > Korg MR-1000 > DSD-DFF 1bit 5.64 Mhz > Audio Gate SW > 24/96 WAV + AUD (shn id 19420) MAC (Taped by Steven Martin, modified Nakamichi CM-700 mics > Sony TC-D5M) > Nak Dragon playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD

ai_review.summary: Matrix mix delivers crisp sound while the April 19 1982 Baltimore show dazzles with a smoking second set featuring Raven Space, The Wheel → Truckin' flow and standout Peggy‑O.
ai_review.review: The Tobin matrix (≈60 % soundboard, 40 % audience) is praised for its clarity and balance, with only occasional drop‑outs on Terrapin Station. Musically the concert is hailed as a killer performance – the second set rolls from The Wheel into Truckin', Stella Blue, Around & Around and Good Lovin' with fire, plus a memorable Raven Space and soaring renditions of Peggy‑O, Cassidy and Brokedown Palace.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average 4.6) and enthusiastic comments about both the performance and the matrix mix; only minor recording hiccups on one song keep it from a perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix blends ~60 % soundboard with ~40 % audience, delivering crisp, balanced audio; occasional cut‑outs noted on Terrapin Station but overall very listenable.

standout_songs: The Wheel → Truckin' → Stella Blue → Around And Around → Good Lovin'
show_quality.setlist_flow: The second set flows seamlessly, especially the transition from The Wheel into Truckin' and the subsequent high‑energy jam sequence; the encore provides a gentle yet satisfying close.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for immaculate vocals, exquisite guitar phrasing and a long, soaring solo (especially on Peggy-O).
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for an emotional moment staying onstage after Brokedown Palace; described as deeply moved by the performance.
